title: Membership after dropping initial smaller elements
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $a,c\in\alpha$, and let $l$ be a list whose entries are pairwise strictly increasing. Then $c$ belongs to the list obtained by dropping the initial entries of $l$ that are less than $a$ if and only if $c$ belongs to $l$ and $a\le c$.
hypotheses_covered: The entries of $l$ are pairwise strictly increasing
